source_type: Existing CC0 3D plant asset, alpha-textured mesh foliage card; converted to voxels
title: Cannabis plants
author: Yughues / Nobiax
license_evidence: Public source page and archive readme.txt explicitly state CC0. Internal readme links Nobiax and Yughues as author aliases.

transformation.method: Preserve original seven-leaflet alpha silhouette; box-filter cell coverage; occupy cells at >=30% coverage; extrude uniform 3-cell thickness. No procedural replacement of leaf silhouette.
transformation.color: Alpha-weighted source texel averages, sRGB gamma 0.65 lift, deterministic RGB k-means into 8 leaf colors; stem color from source trunk atlas.
transformation.modification: Added a straight two-cell-wide petiole at the original source UV junction for attachment; its color is sampled from the original stem atlas.
transformation.orientation: Z up; leaf face in XZ plane; thickness along Y; petiole base on Z=0
transformation.export_mesh_origin: At the center of the petiole base, Z=0; attachment anchor in the exported local mesh is [0,0,0]
transformation.game_export: Surface mesh removes hidden faces only; preserve cubic cells and flat normals; GLB uses standard Y-up conversion.

validation.palette_indexing: RGBA slot 0 maps to voxel index 1; index 0 reserved for empty space

blend_swap_alternative: ctac1287 leaf https://blendswap.com/blend/7651 was not obtained because its public download page requires sign in.
